{
  "dataset_name": "first_order_theorem_proving",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "log_scaled_heavy_tail_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log1p-transformed sum of heavy-tailed high-variance columns to smooth outliers for linear margins.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.abs(V12)) + np.log1p(np.abs(V13)) + np.log1p(np.abs(V15)) + np.log1p(np.abs(V17)) + np.log1p(np.abs(V28)) + np.log1p(np.abs(V29))",
      "value_range": [0.0, 60.0],
      "feature_family": "smoothed_magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses extreme tails into a near-linear severity score useful for SVM hyperplane separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_v12_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Approximate z-score for V12 using training mean and std for stable linear projection.",
      "formula": "(V12 - (-0.0028254997275204466)) / 1.1555012969211211",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 40.0],
      "feature_family": "standardization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides normalized scale for the highly skewed V12 column, beneficial for linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "log1p_v9_v17_v28_product",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-sum interaction between three skewed columns reflecting compound complexity.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.abs(V9)) + np.log1p(np.abs(V17)) + np.log1p(np.abs(V28))",
      "value_range": [0.0, 30.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction_smoothed",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures multiplicative coupling of difficulty signals in a linear-friendly additive log form.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "v14_v32_redundancy_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation between V14 and V32 which share identical training statistics; measures discrepancy.",
      "formula": "np.abs(V14 - V32)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "redundancy_check",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights cases where two near-duplicate columns diverge, providing a sparse linear signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "low_variance_v33_v43_severity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Combined magnitude of low-variance columns V33 and V43 which spike rarely.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.abs(V33)) + np.log1p(np.abs(V43))",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "rare_event_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Surface rare spikes in tight-distribution columns as a smooth severity signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "negative_mass_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum over columns that frequently take negative values, measuring negative directional pressure.",
      "formula": "np.clip(-V1, 0, 5) + np.clip(-V2, 0, 5) + np.clip(-V14, 0, 5) + np.clip(-V32, 0, 5) + np.clip(-V45, 0, 5) + np.clip(-V51, 0, 5)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 30.0],
      "feature_family": "directional_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a one-sided linear projection capturing the negative half-space of bounded columns.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "positive_mass_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum over heavy positive-tail columns capturing upward pressure.",
      "formula": "np.clip(V8, 0, 10) + np.clip(V9, 0, 10) + np.clip(V11, 0, 10) + np.clip(V20, 0, 15) + np.clip(V22, 0, 15) + np.clip(V36, 0, 20)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 80.0],
      "feature_family": "directional_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth bounded composite of positive excursions ideal for linear SVM weight assignment.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "ratio_v13_v15",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of two related skewed magnitude columns with safe denominator.",
      "formula": "(V13 + 1.0) / (np.abs(V15) + 1.0)",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 14.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures relative scaling between two skewed proof-related measurements.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "global_l2_magnitude_smoothed",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Square root of sum of squares of a representative subset, log-smoothed for linear margins.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.sqrt(V1*V1 + V3*V3 + V5*V5 + V7*V7 + V16*V16 + V18*V18 + V19*V19 + V44*V44 + V47*V47 + V49*V49))",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "global_magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth overall row-norm signal that linearly correlates with row activity intensity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "extreme_outlier_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of columns where the value exceeds roughly 3 standard deviations from training mean.",
      "formula": "np.where(np.abs(V12) > 3.5, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V13) > 2.5, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V15) > 2.5, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V17) > 2.8, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V20) > 3.3, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V28) > 3.2, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V29) > 3.0, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(V36) > 3.4, 1, 0)",
      "value_range": [0, 8],
      "feature_family": "outlier_count",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Coarse but linear-friendly count of extreme deviations across heavy-tail features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "row_complexity_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of overall row complexity combining magnitude, spread, and outlier presence into a 0-1 smoothness-friendly score, interpreted as a difficulty proxy.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded smooth scalar summarizing row difficulty, well-suited for linear SVM contribution.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "row_sparsity_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic estimate of how concentrated the row's signal is in a few features versus spread across many, expressed as a 0-1 sparsity index.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_structure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an orthogonal structural signal to magnitude features, helpful for linear separation across heuristic regimes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
